onboarding.label: Getting started
onboarding.title: Get to know SiYe with one search
onboarding.description: Connect the platforms you use, then search for something you care about. Seven short steps walk through every page. Skip whenever you like.
onboarding.connectBody: On the accounts page below, pick a platform you use, click Scan to log in, and scan the code with its mobile app. One or two platforms are enough to start. Continue after you see login confirmed. Finish the login or close the window before searching. If you are already logged into a platform in Chrome or Edge on this computer, you can install the browser extension once and use Sync from browser to bring the session over (optional; scanning works without it). Platforms you skip stay unconnected: search reports them as not logged in and the others still work.
onboarding.homeBody: The home page does two things: take a keyword, and decide which platforms this search covers. The four platform buttons under the search box are checkboxes, not status lights. Only the checked ones take part, and nothing is checked for you: you pick. Start a search with none checked and SiYe asks you to choose at least one. The two panels beside it are recent searches and trending words; picking a trending word searches it right away with your current platform selection. If the home page feels busy, switch to the minimal mode in Settings · Appearance, or use the Customize link in the top bar.
onboarding.homeHint: Search scope: tap the platforms you want to search here.
onboarding.searchBody: Type a keyword and press Enter or the arrow to search; results arrive progressively. Each platform gets its own status block: successful ones show a count, failed ones explain why (not logged in, timed out, rate limited, nothing found), and a failed platform can be retried on its own without touching the others. Above the results you can sort by relevance, recency, or engagement; the input next to the sort menu filters the results you already have by keyword and does not start a new search. If one round is not enough, use Continue search at the end of the list to fetch more.
onboarding.emptyPlatformPrompt: Select at least one platform before searching — these are checkboxes, not status lights.
onboarding.saveBody: Use the bookmark to save a result locally or the clock to add it to Watch Later. Local Favorites lets you organize and back up items; Cross-platform Favorites lets you view items saved on the platforms and keep selected items locally. Sync selected platforms / Continue follows platform favorites and only adds items. Reset sync replaces the local cross-platform favorites for successfully read selected platforms. Neither action changes favorites on the platforms.
onboarding.historyBody: Anything you open is recorded under History so you can find it again. Records stay on this computer and can be deleted at any time.
onboarding.appearanceBody: Settings · Appearance offers eight theme colors with separate light and dark choices that apply immediately, plus a home page mode (minimal or full) that controls how many panels the home page shows. How many items each platform fetches per search is set in Search settings (20 by default): larger numbers are slower and more likely to hit platform limits, so use Continue search on the results page when you need more.
onboarding.helpBody: Help is the permanent manual. The page-by-page tour walks through every screen again whenever you need it, and from here you can also restart this tutorial, read the full scan-login and browser-extension steps, or copy and download a redacted diagnostic report when reporting a problem. Terms and disclaimer live here too.
onboarding.replayHint: Try each step at your own pace, then select Next. You can always restart from Help, where the page-by-page tour covers every screen in more detail.
onboarding.helpIntro: Seven optional steps through accounts, the home page, search, favorites, history, appearance, and help. Finishing stops automatic reminders.
onboarding.storageUnavailable: The browser could not save your preference. The tutorial is closed for now, but may appear next time.

support.title: Need help? Include diagnostics
support.description: Copy your local environment, login verification status, and the status and timing of recent searches and favorites syncs. A preview appears after capture.
support.privacy: Reports exclude cookies, account names, queries, result text, saved content, file paths, and raw logs. Capture does not search platforms or upload anything.
support.copied: Diagnostics copied. Review the report below before pasting it into your feedback.
support.copyFailed: The report is ready, but clipboard access was denied. Select and copy it manually, or download the file.
support.failed: Diagnostics could not be generated. Try again or describe the problem directly.
support.downloadFailed: Download failed. You can select and copy the report below.
support.snapshotHint: This report reflects the app state when it was created and does not contact any platform. Some fields may be empty; please also describe what you were doing when the issue occurred.
